cover.alt: Admissions are currently ongoing for the 2025/2026 academic year.

html:
International travel and tourism institute will organise an orientation programme for prospective students into Airport passenger service and operations (APH) Batch 103, Cabin crew batch 6 and Personal development batch 11.
Orientation is scheduled for 29th August,2025 and 4th September 2025.
Class will resume 9th September 2025.
Venue: ITTI school premises
Time: 0830hrs - 1300hrs
